sn12.42:1.1: sāvatthiyaṃ– atha kho sambahulā bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinne kho te bhikkhu bhagavā etadavoca:
sn12.42:1.2: yato ca kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti. catūhi ca sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato hoti. ariyo cassa ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti suppaṭividdho, so ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ byākareyya.
sn12.42:2.1: katamāni pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti?
sn12.42:2.6: yaṃ bhikkhave surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyī …pe… [bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati …pe… dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ vedayati, surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭiviratassa evaṃ taṃ bhayaṃ veraṃ vūpasantaṃ hoti]
sn12.42:3.2: idha bhikkhave, ariyasāvako buddhe [aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti.] …pe…
sn12.42:4.1: katamo cassa ariyo ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti suppaṭividdho?
sn12.42:4.2: idha bhikkhave, ariyasāvako paṭiccasamuppādaññeva sādhukaṃyoniso manasi karoti …pe…
sn12.42:4.3: ayamassa ariyo ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti suppaṭividdho.
sn12.42:5.1: yato ca kho bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa imāni pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti, imehi catūhi sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato hoti, ayamassa ariyo ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti suppaṭividdho, so ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ byākareyya:
sn12.42:5.2: “khīṇanirayomhi, khīṇatiracchānayoniyo, khīṇapettivisayo, khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo”ti.
